title: Spire and Garden Anew
author: Bram Yarrow
blurb: Lior Voss, a cartographer of unmapped realms, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
